exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs natural delivery)
outcome: Clinical manifestations of CHIKF in neonates
cohort: 169 symptomatic newborns with CHIKF seen at four large regional maternity hospitals in three different Central and South American countries
finding: This study, examining the largest cohort of symptomatic CHIKF neonates to date, found a high vertical transmission rate of CHIKV, with clinical manifestations similar to those previously reported, but a lower percentage of neurological complications, and a comparatively high CFR.
mod_finding: The incidence of congenital disease was unrelated to the use of cesarean section or natural delivery.
